questions.text:
Consider the following C functions.

The value returned by pp(3,4) is _____
questions.solution:
tob(b, arr) stores the binary digits of b (LSB first) and returns their count. b = 4 = 100[latex]{}_2[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] arr = [0, 0, 1], len = 3.

pp computes [latex]a^b[/latex] by repeated squaring: ex goes 3 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 9 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 81, and tot is multiplied only where the bit is 1 (the third bit) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] tot = 81.

[latex]3^4=81[/latex]

Answer: 81

questions.text:
Consider the following C functions.

The return value of fun2(5) is ______
questions.solution:
Both functions keep a static i that is never reset. fun1(n) adds n to its own i and returns it.
fun2(5) adds fun1(5), fun1(4), [latex]\ldots[/latex], fun1(1) to fun2's i:
- fun1(5) = 5, fun1(4) = 9, fun1(3) = 12, fun1(2) = 14, fun1(1) = 15

fun2's i = 5 + 9 + 12 + 14 + 15 = 55

Answer: 55
